analysis: The trial succeeded with host validation macro HR@10 of 0.5613, exceeding the stated 0.505 reference by 0.0563 (5.63 percentage points). Category HR@10 was 0.590 for Movies_and_TV, 0.640 for Industrial_and_Scientific, 0.385 for Electronics, and 0.630 for CDs_and_Vinyl. Electronics remains the weakest category. These results support further investigation of masked-item reconstruction, but do not establish which architectural or training change caused the improvement. No test results were available. The host reported 247.94 allocated GPU-seconds.
code_summary: Trains one independent bidirectional Transformer per category: 96-dimensional embeddings, two attention blocks, two heads, length-64 histories, and 0.25 dropout. Training randomly truncates histories, masks 20% of positions plus the final item, and reconstructs targets using sampled cross-entropy against 512 shared uniform negatives. Scores use normalized, tied item embeddings with a learned scale and jointly trained item biases. AdamW uses learning-rate warmup and gradient clipping. Validation HR@10 selects one checkpoint per category, with NDCG breaking ties. The generated predictor routes by dataset and appends a mask token to the history, loading exactly one trained model per category without ensembling.
